title: PHASEFORM scene
description: A PHASEFORM v0.1 scene document for Phaser 4. Structure only: behavior (draw order, defaults, id uniqueness, valid frames, asset resolution) is defined in README.md and must be enforced by the loader.

version.description: Spec version the file was written against (semver).

key.description: Scene key, matching the key used with Phaser's scene manager.

size.description: Game size in pixels (the Phaser game config width and height). All scenes in a game should agree.

background.description: Background color as a CSS color string.

objects.description: Ordered list of objects. At the scene root, draw order is depth, then list position.

extensions.description: Extension data keyed by lowercase extension name. Loaders must preserve extensions they do not understand.

color.description: Color as #rrggbb. Converted to Phaser's numeric tint.

tintMode.description: Maps to Phaser's TintModes. Default multiply.

blendMode.description: The blend modes WebGL renders natively. Default normal for image, sprite and text; a container has none by default (its children keep their own). Phaser silently treats unknown names as normal, so loaders must reject unknown values.

id.description: Unique within the scene. Uniqueness is not expressible in JSON Schema and must be checked by the loader.

type.description: Object type. Open registry: unknown types are valid and must be preserved.

depth.description: Draw order at the scene root. Ignored for children of a container, where list order decides.

scrollFactor.description: Default {1, 1}. On a container it affects the container only.

data.description: Free key/value data applied with the game object's data manager.

scripts.description: Script paths to attach, relative to the project root.

children.description: Child objects. Valid only for type container.

origin.description: Default {0.5, 0.5} for image and sprite, {0, 0} for text. Invalid on container.

rotation.description: Radians. Phaser normalizes to between -pi and pi.

key.description: Texture key the scene expects to be loaded. PHASEFORM does not define how it is loaded.

frame.description: Frame index or name within the texture. Defaults to the texture's default frame. Phaser silently falls back to the default frame when it is missing, so loaders must validate it.

style.description: Phaser text style config, passed through unchanged (nested shadow and wordWrap objects, padding inside). Phaser defaults: Courier, 16px, white. metrics, if present, must be preserved because it changes text height.
